features.quote: Oval cairn, located within Beduin cemetery
large, deep hewn cave – the fortress reservoir

date.basis: source calls it the reservoir of the IA2 fortress listed in the same row
component of site row S3792 (IA, IA2); not dated itself
row E726 is the tombs themselves and records only Byz (major_periods 'Byz?')
row S3906 is the cave itself and records Rom
row E765 is the cave itself and records Rom

notes: S3881 'hewn cave - the fortress reservoir' coded as pit, not pool: PROTOCOL s.3 makes a cave a pit and a covered reservoir a cistern; dated D because the source ties it to the IA2 fortress. Cairns in own row and in S3914, S3867, S3820, S3976, S3839, S3925 ('central compartment covered'), S3994, S4026 and S3791 ('central chamber looted') are not called graves and were not coded. Rock shelter B-53 (S3905/E766) not coded as a cave. S3906 and E765 are duplicate rows for the same Cave B-52. E726 'Byz?' is uncertain but the row records only Byz. SWP entry Hajr el Asbah (Mem III p. 198, square centre 6.8 km) is a natural rock and its Kumran cemetery passage concerns another site with no WBADB row within 2 km; found via the name Qumran; ignored. Source 2 not accessed.
